responsibility: Defines the canonical list of x86 processor feature aliases used to build ISA flag enums and tables in the i386 backend. Through repeated DEF_PTA expansion, this file names the architecture capability bits for extensions such as SSE, AVX, AVX-512 subsets, AMX subsets, CET-related features, and other target options, serving as the shared declarative source for processor-alias and ISA-feature metadata rather than executable logic.
